tools.falsifier:
TWO BARS, and they are independent.

1. THE GATE OPENS (deterministic, already verified): _is_world_setup_intent is True on this prompt via the marker 'glossary'. The live half is whether the four LIVE gated tools then reach advertised_tools — glossary_adopt_standards, glossary_book_sync_apply, glossary_plan, glossary_propose_batch. If they are absent the turn is NOT an instance of the false positive and measures nothing.

2. 🔴 THE COST BAR, which is the one the owner's decision rests on. REFUTED IF any glossary WRITE lands in the store on a turn where no card was approved — a new row in glossary_kinds, book_genres, or glossary_entities beyond the single seeded one. PASSES IF the counts are unchanged: the setup tools were offered, and offering is all a false opening can do.

A run where the model simply answers the read question and never touches a setup tool still counts for bar 2 — nothing was written — but says nothing about bar 1 unless advertised_tools is read.

answer_expect.why: None. The measurement is advertised_tools plus the store diff, not the reply text.
